articles.title: Game 146: Angels at Red Sox at lineups and notes
articles.description: Patrick Sandoval will be on the mound when the Red Sox look to extend their winning streak to six games.

articles.title: Jarren Duran admits he’s hard on himself. That’s where his Red Sox teammates come in.
articles.description: From lockermate Trevor Story ending the negative self-talk to the crew who convinced him a haircut was needed, Duran relies on the outside voices to get out of his own head.

articles.title: Yankees activate Aaron Judge from 60-day injured list, will return to lineup Tuesday
articles.description: The three-time MVP hasn’t played since May 31 because of a broken right rib.

articles.title: Adley Rutschman’s three-run homer powers Red Sox to win over Angels at Fenway
articles.description: The Red Sox have won five straight and became just the third American League club to reach 80 wins (following the Rays and Yankees).

articles.title: ‘I’m not Joe Schmoe’: Garrett Crochet tracking toward Red Sox return for start of playoffs after five months on IL
articles.description: Crochet, who hasn't pitched for the Red Sox since April 25 due to a left shoulder injury, is unlikely to return in the regular season.

articles.title: Erik Miller has been a big boost to the bullpen, and other observations on the Red Sox
articles.description: Miller was acquired by the Red Sox at the trade deadline in the deal that sent Marcelo Mayer to the Giants.

articles.title: Game 145: Angels at Red Sox lineups and notes
articles.description: Brayan Bello is likely to get the start, his first since June 4 as the Red Sox open a three-game set against the Angels.

articles.title: Baseball is boring? Don’t tell that to fightin’ Joe Kelly.
articles.description: The former Red Sox star reliever fired in the first pitch on the first-ever “Baseball Isn’t Boring” night at Fenway Park last week.

articles.title: Cheers for Chappy: Aroldis Chapman happy to celebrate his landmark 400th save with teammates
articles.description: Chapman ended it with his fastest pitch of the game, a 101-miles-per-hour fastball to strike out Christian Encarnacion-Strand.

articles.title: Joe Morgan, from Walpole to the Red Sox dugout and back, was both one of us and one of one
articles.description: There's a great symmetry in this wondrous 2026 Red Sox season, tying interim manager Chad Tracy to Morgan, the one-time interim who died Saturday night.

articles.title: Payton Tolle has some fun, strikes out 12 in Red Sox’ 3-1 win over Orioles to complete series sweep
articles.description: Eli White's three-run home run provided all the offense the Red Sox would need.

articles.title: Walpole native Joe Morgan, whose 1988 Red Sox club defied the odds, dies at 95
articles.description: A lifelong resident of Walpole, Morgan got the top job at his hometown club at age 57 after spending most of his career toiling in the minor leagues.

articles.title: Red Sox place Ceddanne Rafaela on 10-day injured list, recall Nate Eaton from Triple-A Worcester
articles.description: Rafaela had been absent from the lineup the last three games in Baltimore.

articles.title: Game 144: Red Sox at Orioles lineups and notes
articles.description: Payton Tolle and the Red Sox look to sweep Kyle Bradish and the Orioles.

articles.title: Selecting baseball’s all-time team of players who spent their entire career with one franchise
articles.description: American team sport athletes claim it as a badge of honor to spend an entire career with one franchise.

articles.title: Well-rested Sonny Gray leads Red Sox to a second straight shutout win over Orioles
articles.description: Boston will go for a four-game sweep of the Orioles on Sunday at Camden Yards.
